title: Sparse Topometric Graph
caption: Overview of the proposed cross-session localization and navigation framework. Given depth $D_t$ and odometry $O_t$ inputs, the agent constructs a topometric graph using medial-axis decomposition and assigns geometric descriptors from local point clouds. Node correspondences $M$ are estimated across reference graph $\mathcal{G}^{\text{ref}}$ and current graph $\mathcal{G}^{\text{cur}}$ via graph matching. The correspondences are reused for both localization and navigation. The navigation policy combines the goal-directed score $S_{\text{goal}}$ with the frontier-based exploration score $S_{\text{explore}}$ to select a node as the next waypoint toward the goal position $g$ of the cross-session navigation task.
walkthrough_zh:
- **稀疏拓扑度量图构建（Sec 3.1 Graph Building）**：智能体接收实时深度图 $D_t$ 与里程计位姿 $O_t=(x,y,\theta)$ 构建局部可通行地图，利用中轴分解（Medial-Axis Decomposition）提取稀疏拓扑节点，并聚合节点局部3D点云提取旋转等变几何描述子，结合可通行测地距离边权分别维护先验参考图 $\mathcal{G}^{\text{ref}}$ 与当前在线图 $\mathcal{G}^{\text{cur}}$。
- **跨会话图匹配对应估计（Sec 3.2 FINDCORR）**：在未知初始位姿与部分视野重叠下，利用图匹配网络结合 Sinkhorn 最优传输联合节点几何特征与拓扑邻域连通结构，预测两图间的区域级节点对应集合 $M$。
- **重定位与分数传播导航（Sec 3.3 NAVSCORE）**：一方面基于匹配集 $M$ 经 RANSAC 估计二维刚体变换 $T_{\text{ref}\to\text{cur}} \in \mathrm{SE}(2)$ 实现跨会话全局对齐；另一方面将参考图上的目标距离衰减分数 $S_{\text{goal}}^{\text{ref}}$ 沿对应边 $M$ 传播至当前图得到 $S_{\text{goal}}$，并与前沿探索分数 $S_{\text{explore}}$ 加权融合为综合导航得分 $S_{\text{nav}}$，选取最高分节点作为下一导航航点引导智能体抵达目标 $g$。
